name: Respira Health
summary: Runs a free pulmonary rehabilitation programme over WhatsApp for people with lung disease such as COPD in India.

spending.source: https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/D59GPfsNWHDayPe2c/piloting-a-digital-treatment-for-copd-the-second-biggest (no accounts published: our estimate of spending in its first year, April 2025 to March 2026, from the $110,000 seed grant it called about half its first-year budget, the $66,000 more raised by November 2025 and the $23,000 it then needed to finish the pilot)

lines.label: WhatsApp pulmonary rehabilitation for adults with chronic lung disease in India (scoping, a breathlessness education test and the January-April 2026 pilot)
lines.source: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1jsiCHHch_H3ikQjh7pMB15aHNl5Ss9T5/ (pilot report; one programme, spending our estimate as above)
